## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `--exclude` flag should be fixed because it breaks the project's CLI-flag rule: it does not read its default from an `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` environment variable, so CI cannot set exclusions.

## Changes
The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` option. `collect()` uses `fnmatch` to skip files whose base name matches any of the patterns and logs each skipped path. The pull request also documents the flag in `docs/flags.md` and adds unit and end-to-end tests plus a text fixture.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the `--exclude` default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — The new flag uses `default=[]`, so when CI sets `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and runs `archive src`, `.log` files are still archived. This breaks `.claude/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11`: "Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable". — CI pipelines that set options through the environment cannot exclude files and will archive content they meant to skip. — Fix: Set the default from `os.environ.get("ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE")`, choose how it splits into multiple patterns (for example `os.pathsep`), document it in `docs/flags.md:7`, and add a test next to `test_exclude_defaults_to_nothing`.
